rv.q: “Parton's somewhat hallucinatory musical is a wilfully preposterous crowd-pleaser...Although this show started out...in 2005, it feels pretty post-Weinstein, with its uncompromising focus on male shitness and violent retribution...The plot is about as ridiculous as these women’s ultra-glam interpretation of ‘office wear’...
This musical version swamps its story in inch-thick makeup and foot-high hair.
It was an appropriately kitsch beginning to this pantomimey adaptation, which sticks close to the script of the 1980 hit film but fails to replicate its sharp spirit entirely.
Reader, the goods are not all there.
